intermediate.candidate_rule: Replay the exact 25 and 35 proposals and require the regenerated SAM masks to match every frozen mask hash.

evaluation.truth_timing: Build and rank all 3D tracks without target identity, target box, or IoU; evaluate the already-frozen truth afterward.

geometry.lift: Lift each proposal SAM mask through its RGB-D frame into scan coordinates using the frozen intrinsics and camera pose.
geometry.pair_score: Geometric mean of depth-consistent mask coverage in both projection directions.
geometry.candidate_score: Best cross-frame pair score; rank mutual-best pairs first, then symmetric coverage, objectness, and frozen candidate index.

literature_motivation.name: MV3DIS
literature_motivation.use: Cross-view 2D masks are associated by 3D coverage and depth consistency instead of independent per-frame confidence.

literature_motivation.name: SAMPro3D
literature_motivation.use: 3D-located evidence aligns SAM masks across posed RGB-D views without task-specific training.

gate.requirements: The reachable correct proposal in both frames must enter the geometry-only top three, at least one rank must improve over the original fused order, and neither may regress.

next_action: On the next unopened source-queue family, freeze three adjacent query views and use the same 3D mask-track candidate generator before any target appearance scoring.
fallback_action: Close adjacent-frame persistence as insufficient on ARV and move to active viewpoint selection that explicitly maximizes candidate-track separation; do not add ARV-specific thresholds or appearance weights.
claim_boundary: ARV is a consumed Development family. Geometry-only persistence can diversify proposal hypotheses but cannot identify target ownership or establish portal access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety.
